summary: ServeSync full-stack tested end-to-end. Backend: 15/15 pytest cases pass (menu CRUD, order lifecycle, status filter, 404s, _id leak checks, invalid transitions). Frontend: role selection -> master menu -> ADD/stepper -> sticky cart -> cart modal (table+notes) -> place order -> auto-navigates to orders tab; chef pending -> Start Preparing removes ticket -> Preparing tab -> Mark Complete moves to Completed tab; Manage add-menu-item works. All testIDs present as documented. Every core happy-path flow works.

ui_bugs.issue: Delete confirmation uses Alert.alert with Cancel/Delete buttons; on React Native Web this often renders only a window.alert (single OK button) so the Delete callback never fires from the web preview. Works on native iOS/Android. Consider using a custom confirm Modal for web parity.

issues: All seeded menu items render the same Unsplash placeholder image (meat plate) because seed data has no image_base64 and PLACEHOLDER_IMG is a single hardcoded URL. Visually confusing – a Cold Coffee card shows a meat photo. Recommend either seeding image_base64 per item or using name-based deterministic placeholders.

react_native_issues.issue: Uses props.pointerEvents='box-none' – deprecated on RN Web (warning in console). Move to style.pointerEvents.
'shadow*' style props are deprecated on RN Web (console warning). Migrate to boxShadow for web parity.

action_items: (LOW) Replace Alert.alert delete confirm in master/manage.tsx with a custom Modal so the delete flow also works on RN Web preview.
(LOW) Provide unique placeholder/hero images per seeded menu item so cards don’t all look identical.
(NIT) Silence RN Web deprecation warnings: switch shadow* -> boxShadow in theme.ts and props.pointerEvents -> style.pointerEvents on sticky cart wrapper.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly excludes _id via projection={'_id': 0} everywhere and uses Literal enums for status – good.

OrderStatusUpdate accepts any of the 3 states – no server-side guard that transitions follow pending->preparing->completed. Currently frontend only exposes the forward transition, but backend allows arbitrary jumps (e.g., completed -> pending). Consider enforcing state machine if strict flow is required.
api.ts uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL correctly with no fallback – good.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up TEST_Dosa (backend pytest) and TEST_UI_Item (UI test). All removed after tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 15 pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/test_servesync.py can be reused as regression. Frontend selectors that work: role-master-card, role-chef-card, add-to-cart-<id>, stepper-inc/dec-<id>, open-cart-btn, cart-table-input, cart-notes-input, place-order-btn, ticket-action-<id>, menu-name-input, menu-price-input, save-menu-item-btn, delete-item-<id>. Note the manage 'Add to menu' button is save-menu-item-btn (not menu-add-btn).
rca_of_issue: N/A – no functional bugs. Only cosmetic/RN-web polish suggestions.
